dark.af-gradient-color: radial-gradient(ellipse at 12% 8%, #8B5CF6, transparent 68%), radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%, #22D3EE, transparent 68%), radial-gradient(ellipse at 88% 92%, #34D399, transparent 68%)
